in_marathi.name: Sohidul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sohidul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit and Bengali origin, Sohidul means 'Gift of God'. This name is deeply rooted in Hinduism and is perfect for a boy born under the Moon sign, embodying the traits of loyalty and devotion.
